description: Return what to fix across the apps of one organization: groups of the same finding rule open in two or more projects (rule, gate, highest severity, affected projectIds, a sample message and one paste-ready fix prompt), the Mushi SDK version per project and package (current | behind | unknown), and integrations most sibling projects have but one lacks. Open means the latest completed gate run per project and gate, not allowlisted; info findings are left out. Optional organizationId as for get_portfolio. Needs an account-level key. Returns { organizationId, groups, sdkSkew, holes, crossProject, readErrors }; a part named in readErrors is unknown, not empty. Read-only. Fix a group repo by repo with list_gate_findings in each project.

organizationId.description: Organization UUID — defaults to the key owner's only organization when omitted
